rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday way to mean a person who lives in a particular place.

example.english: Every inhabitant who lives in this area says the transport is convenient.
example.traditional: 住喺呢區嘅人都話交通方便。
example.jyutping: zyu6 hai2 ni1 keoi1 ge3 jan4 dou1 waa6 gaau1 tung1 fong1 bin6

rows.note: Use this concise noun for inhabitants of an area, community, or habitat, including non-human inhabitants in suitable contexts.

example.english: Each inhabitant of this village is very helpful.
example.traditional: 呢條村嘅居民個個都好熱心。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 cyun1 ge3 geoi1 man4 go3 go3 dou1 hou2 jit6 sam1

rows.note: Use this when referring to residents as households or occupants of a building or housing estate rather than as individual people.

example.english: The building management notified every inhabitant that the water would be cut off on Saturday.
example.traditional: 管理處通知住戶星期六會停水。
example.jyutping: gun2 lei5 cyu3 tung1 zi1 zyu6 wu6 sing1 kei4 luk6 wui5 ting4 seoi2
